description1: UniPool is a comprehensive carpooling platform that connects you across India with seamless ride-sharing solutions. Whether hosting or joining rides, the platform's dynamic search capabilities work nationwide, from campus trips to intercity travel, breaking free from predefined route limitations.
description2: Real-time notifications keep users updated on ride status, bookings, and acceptances, while built-in group messaging connects all the riders for easy coordination. Direct messaging enables one-on-one communication between riders and hosts. Powered by a proprietary search algorithm with advanced filtering, UniPool intelligently matches riders with optimal routes and schedules. The platform transforms carpooling into a connected travel community, making intercity and local travel more accessible, affordable, and social especially for VIT students.
